    The quiver of a finite ray category #

    For a ray category P with finitely many objects, the quiver Q_P has the objects as vertices and the irreducible morphisms as arrows (Gabriel–Roiter 13.6). A directed path of Q_P evaluates to a morphism of P (pathMor), evaluation turns concatenation into composition, and every nonzero non-isomorphism is the value of a path (exists_path).
